comments.content: mp_autovflip_create initializes p->prev_vflip to -1 but leaves p->prev_imgfmt and p->target_vflip uninitialized. The first comparison img->imgfmt == p->prev_imgfmt and later use of p->target_vflip is therefore undefined behaviour. Initialise prev_imgfmt to -1 and target_vflip to 0, and reset them in vflip_reset.

On non-video frames and on the 'video input required!' error path the function returns without calling mp_subfilter_continue(&p->sub). This drops the frame and can stall the subfilter chain. The subfilter should be continued even on error, e.g. mp_subfilter_continue(&p->sub); return;

The plane is built with .flipped = layout.params.vflip and then mp_image_vflip(mpi) is called unconditionally when mpi->params.vflip is set. Flipping the image data in place while keeping the flipped flag true causes a double flip / inconsistent upload state. Either clear the flipped flag after the in-place flip or remove the in-place flip and rely on the flipped flag.
